contention_probe.interpretation: The five-second probe did not directly observe external SM use, but it cannot establish that the process was inactive throughout the affected domains.

assessment.timing_validity: Conservatively mark late ldm_100 onward as potentially shared-compute contaminated; do not use these domains as clean timing evidence.

assessment.conclusion: The external process explains the new host-memory plateau. It was observed only and not modified; prediction results remain usable while host-memory and timing claims are qualified.
